project.title: The Ethiopian Coffee Ceremony
project.visual_style: Cinematic documentary photography, warm natural light, authentic Ethiopian coffee ceremony details, respectful cultural representation.

shots.visual_description: An Ethiopian home at sunrise, preparing for a traditional coffee ceremony.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic documentary photograph of a welcoming Ethiopian home at sunrise, warm golden natural light, traditional coffee ceremony setting, authentic details, realistic, respectful cultural representation, no text.
shots.motion_prompt: A gentle slow camera push toward the coffee ceremony setting; soft morning light changes subtly.
shots.narration_am: በኢትዮጵያ ቡና ከመጠጥነት በላይ ትርጉም አለው።
shots.subtitle_en: In Ethiopia, coffee means more than a drink.
shots.reason: Introduce the setting and central idea.

shots.visual_description: A host carefully arranges the coffee ceremony materials.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic documentary photograph of an Ethiopian coffee ceremony host arranging a jebena, small cups and a traditional woven tray, warm home interior, natural light, authentic details, no text.
shots.motion_prompt: The camera slowly pans across the arranged coffee ceremony objects; hands move gently into frame.
shots.narration_am: የቡና ሥነ ሥርዓት እንግዳ መቀበያና መተሳሰብ ምልክት ነው።
shots.subtitle_en: The coffee ceremony is a symbol of hospitality and connection.
shots.reason: Show the care and preparation behind the ceremony.

shots.visual_description: Fresh green coffee beans being washed and prepared.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up cinematic documentary photograph of fresh green coffee beans being washed and prepared for a traditional Ethiopian coffee ceremony, authentic hands and utensils, natural textures, no text.
shots.motion_prompt: A close camera view follows the gentle movement of beans and water.

shots.image_prompt: Cinematic close-up of coffee beans roasting in a traditional pan over charcoal during an Ethiopian coffee ceremony, gentle smoke, warm firelight, realistic documentary style, no text.
shots.motion_prompt: Coffee beans are gently stirred as a thin trail of smoke rises; steady camera.
shots.narration_am: በሚጠበስበት ጊዜ የቡናው መዓዛ ቤቱን ይሞላል።
shots.subtitle_en: As the beans roast, their aroma fills the home.
shots.reason: Capture the recognizable aroma and sensory experience.

shots.image_prompt: Documentary close-up of roasted Ethiopian coffee beans being ground using a traditional mortar and pestle, warm light, detailed textures, authentic setting, no text.
shots.motion_prompt: Hands gently grind the roasted beans in a traditional mortar; close steady framing.
shots.subtitle_en: The roasted beans are ground and prepared for brewing.
shots.reason: Show the next stage of preparation.

shots.visual_description: Coffee brewing in a traditional jebena.
shots.image_prompt: Traditional Ethiopian clay jebena coffee pot brewing over a small heat source, gentle steam, intimate home setting, cinematic documentary photography, no text.
shots.motion_prompt: Steam rises gently from the jebena; slow camera movement toward the pot.
shots.subtitle_en: The coffee slowly brews in the jebena.
shots.reason: Highlight the traditional brewing vessel and process.

shots.visual_description: Coffee being poured into small traditional cups.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic close-up of Ethiopian coffee being poured from a traditional jebena into small cups arranged on a woven tray, warm natural light, realistic documentary style, no text.
shots.motion_prompt: A steady stream of coffee is poured carefully into small cups; gentle camera follow.
shots.subtitle_en: Coffee is served with care to everyone gathered.
shots.reason: Show the sharing and serving moment.

shots.visual_description: Family and guests sharing coffee and conversation.
shots.image_prompt: Warm cinematic documentary photograph of an Ethiopian family and guests sharing coffee together in a welcoming home, natural expressions, traditional coffee cups, respectful authentic representation, no text.
shots.motion_prompt: Guests exchange gentle smiles and conversation; slow camera drift across the gathering.
shots.narration_am: በቡና ዙሪያ ቤተሰብና ጎረቤት በአንድነት ይሰበሰባሉ።
shots.subtitle_en: Families and neighbours gather in unity around coffee.

shots.visual_description: A close view of coffee cups and the shared ceremony.
shots.image_prompt: Poetic cinematic close-up of small Ethiopian coffee cups on a traditional woven tray, people softly visible in the background, warm light, documentary photography, no text.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow focus shift from the coffee cups to the gathering in the background.
shots.narration_am: ይህ ልማድ ወግን፣ ወዳጅነትንና ባህልን ያገናኛል።
shots.subtitle_en: This tradition brings together heritage, friendship and culture.
shots.reason: Reflect on the meaning of the tradition.

shots.visual_description: The coffee ceremony setting in a peaceful closing scene.
shots.image_prompt: Beautiful final cinematic view of an Ethiopian coffee ceremony setting with jebena, cups, incense and woven tray, warm evening light, documentary photography, no text, space for end title.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle pullback from the coffee ceremony setting; peaceful fade toward the end.
shots.narration_am: ቡና የኢትዮጵያ መስተንግዶ፣ አንድነትና ባህል ሕያው ምልክት ነው።
shots.subtitle_en: Coffee is a living symbol of Ethiopian hospitality, unity and heritage.
shots.reason: End with the central cultural message.
